body:
Why is Zac a Teamspeak Developer?
Who was involved in the decision?
Why wasn't it publicly announced that he was promoted, the 3 other TS Devs were publicly announced?
Why was he worthy enough to get this position?
What is his role as a TeamSpeak Developer/What does he do?
How does he benefit the staff team?

Oh and why can only Seniors respond to threads in This subforum?
It really restricts discussion and communication between the Sr.Staff and the community, which contradicts why this subforum was put up in the first place.

Chur bros.

title: Why is Zac a Teamspeak Developer?

replies.author: Arigenn
replies.body:
I'll go through your questions, and answer them to the best I can (with what I am allowed to release publicly)

Why is Zac TeamSpeak Developer
We believed that Zac has a variety of skills despite some of his behaviour, and they fit the teamspeak dev criteria quite well.

Who was involved in the decision
TeamSpeak developers (seth Michael and venny), along with the admins a bit down the road.

Publicly announced
A bit of a mistake on our part, but all TeamSpeak developers were willing to sit and talk with anyone wondering. Previously, the teamspeak developers only got a special thread specifically only saying "Congratulations, new TeamSpeak dev!" They never provided reasons for promotion. I can only name very few promotions we made with a special post dedicated to them, and giving specific reasons why they were promoted.

Why was he worthy enough
He had the skills and knowledge on how to properly run a teamspeak, and was very able to handle a lot of ts situations

His role
He started off on a bit of a trial, but now he just does what the other teamspeak developers do, develop Teamspeak.

How does he benefit the staff team
Carries out teamspeak work, so we can concentrate on other items that are more important :l

I`ll leave this open for further questions, cheers.
